snippet.title: Hasbro Games™ Junior Collection | Announce Trailer | US | ESRB
snippet.description:
🎲 Roll the dice, crack the case, and race through life. Game night starts now! 

Introducing the Hasbro Games TM  Junior Collection: a playful party video game featuring junior versions of Monopoly, Clue/Cluedo, and The Game of Life! ✨ 

Play your favorite Hasbro boardgames. Whether you're solving mysteries, collecting properties, or spinning your way through life, every match is packed with family-friendly fun for players of all ages. 

🎮 Coming to Nintendo Switch 1 & 2, PlayStation, Xbox, and PC. 

Learn more 👉 https://outrightgames.com/?post_type=game&p=26983&preview=true
